10537|c27b3101.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
10537|c27b3101.text: We cannot take care of all the threats in this area alone. We could use another fighting hand, $N.

11044|386a9ec7.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|386a9ec7.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $N, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

11071|f5e60885.name: Mot Dawnstrider
11071|f5e60885.text: What I wouldn't give to be out on the open plains on a day like this... but, my duty binds me.

11901|c5ceacbe.name: Andruk
11901|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12616|c5ceacbe.name: Vhulgra
12616|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12724|39b67c2e.name: Pixel
12724|39b67c2e.text: This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.

12757|9b4e17a6.name: Karang Amakkar
12757|9b4e17a6.text: Greeting $c - welcome to the front lines in our conquest of Ashenvale!  If you are looking for something to do, then you've come to the right place.  I'm always looking for able-bodied individuals to help bring glory to the Horde!

14728|9cac81e8.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
14728|9cac81e8.text:
Hail brother... I'd like a moment of your time, if I may.

We tauren have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing our homeland.  We now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of tauren everywhere in helping us out!

15350|44b49612.name: Horde Warbringer
15350|44b49612.text: War is upon us, $N.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2425|7dca81fc.name: Varimathras
2425|7dca81fc.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

246349|da04ef25.name: Breton Samuels
246349|da04ef25.text:
If you've come seeking the fellowship of your fellow paladins, you've come to the right place. 

Welcome home.

246389|8e0ab317.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|8e0ab317.text:
Why do they call me "The Breaker"?

Trust me, you don't want to know.

246389|b676ae27.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|b676ae27.text:
A little bit of a lot of things. Mostly I take the soft and weak and reshape them into hardened fighters once again.

It's a tough world out there, and even our own people mistrust us. We need to be tough and self-reliant if we are to fit into this "Horde" with the rest of our people.

246393|4b78c376.name: Jorin Croge
246393|4b78c376.text: There are many things lurking out there in the dark and the light is needed now more than ever. If only these poor souls could see that just because our world has changed doesn't mean we have to be the monsters that the living think we are.

246393|533ec9c8.name: Jorin Croge
246393|533ec9c8.text:
I make sure we are provisioned and that the scant resources we do have are distributed properly.

If this were a proper order, I'd be something of a quartermaster. Such as we are, however, I just do my best to make sure we are at least somewhat equipped to deal with the dangers all around us.

246394|63539e70.name: Ander Solliden
246394|63539e70.text: In my previous life, I lived nearby here. I still wander the fields of my childhood farmstead occasionally. It fills me with sadness to see those I knew and loved, shambling around as mindless thralls. It pains me, but it's that very pain that gives me strength and purpose.

246394|82d61c10.name: Ander Solliden
246394|82d61c10.text:
Mostly the usual. Murloc attacks, the occasional Scarlet Crusade skirmish. There are even some paladins that can't quite adjust to life as a Forsaken. Far too often we have to put those down that turn their blades upon their brothers. 

By far the worst is when some mindless thrall wanders too close. I can kill murlocs all day, but some of the scourge I've had to destroy were former friends of mine. Some were even family members.

I'd rather it be me who puts them down than some random adventurer, but it still stings.

257655|9f0fb116.name: Deathguard Billmuth
257655|9f0fb116.text: <Deathguard Billmuth absentmindedly fidgets as he looks around nervously. He is clearly very uncomfortable being here.>

263570|8ac1454b.name: Creeg Bothunk
263570|8ac1454b.text: Greetings, traveler! I am Creeg Bothunk, the main supplier for the Darkspear Raiders. As you improve your standing with the Darkspear Raiders, I will be able to provide a variety of goods that you can use inside Darkspear Islands. Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.

267009|6f316d7a.name: Hadric Harlson
267009|6f316d7a.text: Be careful, $c. There are cultists nearby.

270582|e6b98502.name: Mon'ye
270582|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

276067|2af62916.name: Angus Hammerhand
276067|2af62916.text:
It's my job to get the Paladins of Bandarion Keep set up with proper arms and armor. It's not much, but it's honest work.

I've got a thing or two for sale as well, should you need gear.

2798|a28d29e1.name: Pand Stonebinder
2798|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3011|463ccfcd.name: Teg Dawnstrider
3011|463ccfcd.text: Enchanting has run in our family for generations. I learned at an early age, just as my son is doing now.

3026|48c1c064.name: Aska Mistrunner
3026|48c1c064.text: Wulan in Shadowprey Village can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".  You will need that if you are to better yourself.

3028|c2467ddc.name: Kah Mistrunner
3028|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

3041|4711dbab.name: Torm Ragetotem
3041|4711dbab.text: No matter how much one learns, there is always more to know.

3043|4711dbab.name: Ker Ragetotem
3043|4711dbab.text: No matter how much one learns, there is always more to know.

3057|690a7170.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
3057|690a7170.text:
Greetings young one, and welcome to Thunder Bluff.  You'll find safe refuge from the burdens of the world here.  All denizens of the Horde are welcome here.

The spirits of the present and past come alive here in this sacred place, my friend.  Honor them, and in doing so honor yourself.

3084|86e3802f.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|86e3802f.text: Strong of body and spirit.  There can be no stronger combination!  Find your destiny with Sark Ragetotem in the Hunter's Hall.

3084|8c257f1a.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|8c257f1a.text: Aspiring to join our ranks one day?  Sark Ragetotem can help you on your way.  He's in the Hunter's Hall.

3084|f7079359.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|f7079359.text:
There is no finer cook in Thunder Bluff than Aska Mistrunner.  Mmmmm, I can smell what she is cooking from here.  Head over to her kitchen located on the high rise.

Drat... now I am hungry.

3084|fcb23436.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|fcb23436.text: Life is a struggle, and the saying that which does not kill you makes you stronger is not always true.  Sometimes wounds act slowly, which is why we have bandages.  Pand Stonebinder of the Spirit Rise can teach you the art of First Aid.

3142|99ae9589.name: Orgnil Soulscar
3142|99ae9589.text: Hail.  Be brief, for we both have much to do.

3173|1605f087.name: Swart
3173|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3191|0c543544.name: Cook Torka
3191|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3216|1672ee12.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|1672ee12.text:
Naive fool. The Burning Blade IS the Shadow Council! There are many cults and organizations under the Council's rule, but all of them are just extensions of their will. I may lead the Burning Blade, but I am still just as much a pawn to the Council as you are to me!

Look at the Searing Blade--most of them think they are becoming the next rising group of powerful warlocks that they will replace the Shadow Council.

3216|2e9c14b6.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|2e9c14b6.text: Haha! Save for their leaders--the satyr, Bazzalan, and the warlock Jergosh--yes, all of them. That is why I constantly send Thrall's worshippers at them. It gives Thrall the impression that I am weeding out the evil in the bowels of his great city. The victory is in reality two-fold: kill Thrall's faithful and test the strength of those in the Searing Blade to see if they are truly worthy of joining me.

3216|9353e287.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|9353e287.text:
Ah, one of our own. It is good to see our numbers are growing so rapidly that I can no longer keep track of the faces of our members.

That fool Thrall thinks I am working hard to cleanse the image of warlocks and prove we are his servants. Idiot! The Burning Legion will make ash of this entire world after it drains it completely.

3216|e0c203bc.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|e0c203bc.text: I will make it known to you. You are obviously already proving yourself in our ranks to become a lieutenant so quickly. Perhaps you can return to me later and I will have tasks for you. The council adores those skilled in the arcane, but servants of all kinds are always welcome, no matter their profession.

3338|e2ff6310.name: Sergra Darkthorn
3338|e2ff6310.text: The land, the water, and the sky are all as one. It is your eyes that deceive you with such separation. The Earthmother is all those things and more.

3344|1605f087.name: Kardris Dreamseeker
3344|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3390|eb12150e.name: Apothecary Helbrim
3390|eb12150e.text: The Barrens holds a wealth of substances for which we, the apothecaries or Lordaeron, may find use.

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3433|ac5dfa0b.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|ac5dfa0b.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and $r cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3489|68d65f37.name: Zargh
3489|68d65f37.text: Have a look at my meats, friend.  You won't want to go out into the Barrens without a good stock of provisions.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4452|a84fd61d.name: Kravel Koalbeard
4452|a84fd61d.text:
Come a little closer.  We have important matters to discuss, you and I.

And some of them we don't want everyone to hear...

4453|f1c43d2c.name: Wizzle Brassbolts
4453|f1c43d2c.text: Be careful where you put that foot of yours, mister. We're not all blessed with the lofty height of a $r.

4611|caaefc10.name: Doctor Herbert Halsey
4611|caaefc10.text: My colleagues and I are gathering the deadliest substances we know and testing their effects on our enemies. Once I have everything I need, I shall brew such plagues as this world has never seen.

4877|fe134d60.name: Jandia
4877|fe134d60.text: Hail, friend. Can I interest you in any of my trade supplies?

4949|9255c79c.name: Thrall
4949|9255c79c.text:
It would be wise to explain to you the depths at which our enemies will go to to hide themselves under our noses.

Know this first and foremost: our enemy is the Shadow Council. No matter what task I give you, or who I ask you to act against, know that one simple fact.

Many cults exist within the Council, but only to hide its actions against the foolish.

Groups like the Burning Blade, the Argus Wake, and the Searing Blade are all tools of the Council. Consider them one and the same.

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

5943|a28d29e1.name: Rawrk
5943|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6496|28f510c2.name: Brivelthwerp
6496|28f510c2.text: Can I interest you in some ice-cold ice cream?

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

7683|a4ef73af.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|a4ef73af.text: Welcome to Blue Moon Odds and Ends, $c.  If you have any questions, please let me know.

8359|6fec0ef7.name: Ahanu
8359|6fec0ef7.text: Greetings.  If you are here for leather goods, then you will find my wares well crafted.

9087|e4fd33dd.name: Bashana Runetotem
9087|e4fd33dd.text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

1464-complete.name: Telf Joolam
1464-complete.text:
May fire burn within your heart, $N.

The elements await you.
1464-complete.title: Fire Sapta

1718-accept.name: Torm Ragetotem
1718-accept.text:
Your renown as a $c grows, $N.  Now it is time to pit yourself against your peers and see where you stand.

There is an island off the coast of the Barrens, south of Ratchet.  It is called Fray Island and it is a place where warriors meet.

Meet, and fight.

Speak with the chief $c of Fray Island, Klannoc Macleod.  If he finds you worthy, then Klannoc will lead you further down the $c's path.

To reach Fray Island, search for the sand bar shallows along the Merchant Coast.
1718-accept.title: The Islander

813-accept.name: Kor'ghan
813-accept.text:
Venomtails are some of the deadliest scorpids in Durotar. It was unwise for Rhinag to hunt them without having some of the antidote with him, but right now, chastising is the last thing he needs.

Bring me a few venomtail poison sacs from any of the venomtails near the entrance of Orgrimmar and I'll make an antidote for him.

Make haste, $N. One of our own needs your help.
813-accept.title: Finding the Antidote

813-complete.name: Kor'ghan
813-complete.text: Here is the antidote, $N. Take it to Rhinag as soon as you can, and be cautious.
813-complete.title: Finding the Antidote

813-progress.name: Kor'ghan
813-progress.text: Remember, no matter what creature you hunt, you would do well to study it and understand its behavior. That knowledge could save your life.
813-progress.title: Finding the Antidote

98069-complete.name: Jandia
98069-complete.text: Thank you, $N. These supplies will help get us through until the next shipment arrives.
98069-complete.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies

98069-progress.name: Jandia
98069-progress.text: Have you been able to recover the supplies the harpies stole?
98069-progress.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies

98070-complete.name: Jandia
98070-complete.text: This is wonderful news! I will send word to our suppliers that the harpies have been dealt with. At least that is one less threat the future caravans will need to worry about.
98070-complete.title: Stop the Screeching
